image_case_selection: All and only eight R0 natural99 frames in previously frozen E2 mismatch categories; ID order; no best-outcome selection.
limitations: IoU>=0.5 diagnoses reference-box overlap, not independently verified physical identity.
Reference box is min/max of all eight stored corners, includes occluded/extrapolated/off-image points; no clipped-box redefinition.
Visual cone-location observations are posthoc evidence, never new real training labels.
Historical PRE_V2 uses old161 population/checkpoint; do not adopt its metrics or gates for current full128.
FAST teacher cache has no direct current-checkpoint SHA receipt and no boxes; code path/filename alone insufficient for bit-exact cache reuse.
No claim that a box switch by itself gives stable joint T/R gain.
